rows.note: Use this for the common oil-refinery meaning; it is the everyday choice when the product is oil.

example.english: This refinery processes a lot of crude oil every day.
example.traditional: 呢間煉油廠每日處理好多原油。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 lin6 jau4 cong2 mui5 jat6 cyu2 lei5 hou2 do1 jyun4 jau4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a plant refining metals, sugar, or other materials rather than specifically oil.

example.english: That refinery specializes in turning ore into metal.
example.traditional: 嗰間精煉廠專門將礦石煉成金屬。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zing1 lin6 cong2 zyun1 mun4 zoeng3 kwong3 sek6 lin6 sing4 gam1 suk6
